claims.text: Architect Jose Luis Moreno began by building a restaurant between the jungle and sea, then added rooms and suites over the years for friends and family.

findings.quote: He fell in love with the Riviera Maya and built a restaurant between the jungle and sea. Over the years he would add rooms and suites to accommodate his friends and family

claims.text: Interior architect Tara Bernerd led the redesign, working with local artisans.

findings.quote: interior architect Tara Bernerd sought to retain and enhance the natural beauty of the space
Working with local artisans

claims.text: All construction materials of the redesign (wood, stone, iron and ceramic) were sourced from Mexico.

findings.quote: All construction materials—the wood, stone, iron and ceramic—were sourced from Mexico.

claims.text: Casa Mayor echoes Moreno's original restaurant, with original features preserved.

findings.quote: Moreno’s original restaurant echoes through to today’s Casa Mayor, where original features are preserved

claims.text: Maroma Spa by Guerlain draws on the resort's history of Mayan wellness philosophy and offers sound and healing rituals.

findings.quote: Maroma Spa by Guerlain combines the resort’s history of Mayan wellness philosophy with Guerlain’s savoir-faire, infusing the pampering menu with new therapies including sound and healing rituals.

claims.text: The resort has Freddy's Bar and a second bar, Bambuco, described as a playful, vibrant Mexican space for sundowners.

findings.quote: Alongside long-time favourite Freddy’s Bar, Bambuco is another new bar that invites travellers into a playful, vibrant Mexican space for an unforgettable sundowner.

claims.text: Maroma is thirty miles south of Cancun.

findings.quote: Thirty miles south of Cancun

claims.text: The curved stucco buildings are aligned to Mayan geometry.

findings.quote: the curved stucco buildings are aligned to Mayan geometry

claims.text: Casa Mayor, from Mexican-born chef Daniel Camacho, uses ingredients from the Yucatan peninsula and is where breakfast is served.

findings.quote: Casa Mayor, a new spot from Mexican-born chef Daniel Camacho that incorporates a slew of ingredients from the Yucatán peninsula
Casa Mayor is also where breakfast is served

claims.text: Architect Jose Luis Moreno built the original hotel without blueprints, using free-flowing designs sketched into the sand.

findings.quote: never using blueprints, he instead opted for free-flowing designs sketched into the sand

claims.text: Woodend, a restaurant from Australian chef Curtis Stone, focuses on seafood cooked over an open flame.

findings.quote: Woodend, the new restaurant from Australian chef Curtis Stone, has a focus on exceptional seafood cooked over an open flame.

claims.text: Maroma works with Fundacion Selva Maya and Mayahuum to protect the endangered Melipona bee, the stingless bee sacred to the Mayan people.

findings.quote: Maroma is also continuing its work with local organisations Fundación Selva Maya and Mayahuum to protect the endangered Melipona bee, the stingless bee which was sacred to the Mayan people.

claims.text: 80 percent of the property's furnishings and objects were made in Mexico.

findings.quote: 80 percent of the property’s furnishings and objects were made in Mexico

claims.text: An excursion to a cenote about a 30-minute drive away is offered, with a guide from 4World Expeditions.

findings.quote: the excursion to a cenote about a 30-minute drive away
my guide, Anna, with 4World Expeditions

claims.text: The property is reached along a modest gravel road winding through mangroves off the main highway.

findings.quote: Winding through thick mangroves
along a modest gravel road
once you turn off the main highway for Maroma

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the secluded location requires transportation for off-resort activities.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the exclusive positioning.
